set.body: Close the epic with evidence against the intended experience and numerical semantics. Add realistic scenarios for in-memory and external roots, chained affine and nonlinear transforms, volume-to-surface routing, target selections, repeated evaluation, and materialization. Acceptance: independent coordinate and resampling fixtures from trusted reference implementations catch direction, convention, and double-interpolation errors; instrumented tests prove no eager IO and demand narrowing; benchmarks record compilation reuse, source bytes read, allocations, and chained-view cost; affected module tests pass on JVM and JS warning-clean; spatial README and architecture docs teach the final API, limitations, and extension protocol.
set.title: Spatial lazy acceptance gate: independent oracles, scenarios, performance, and docs
